record_type_quote: This study had two goals: to replicate research by Marilyn Roberts and Maxwell McCombs on intermedia agenda setting in a Spanish election and to explore that pattern of intermedia relationships at both the first and second levels of agenda setting.

targets.evidence_quote: This study had two goals: to replicate research by Marilyn Roberts and Maxwell McCombs on intermedia agenda setting in a Spanish election and to explore that pattern of intermedia relationships at both the first and second levels of agenda setting.
targets.outcome_quote: Similar to Roberts and McCombs' findings in a Texas gubernatorial election, the newspaper agenda in Spain did influence the agenda of issues in television news.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly compares the newspaper-to-television agenda result with the target and reports agreement. The reference list is unavailable, so target title and year are left blank.
